mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 2.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO rise above their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS above 150,000) consistently signals a healthy labor market and rising consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1,000 thousand units indicates weakening residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise above their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100) indicates weakening industrial output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds from reduced demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
